items.text: Let it be — Gavin's prayer was a thank-you and a sign-off, not a question, and answering "you're welcome" into the air would just be a voice interrupting a man settling down to rest. I checked the Cave Mouth while I was here: no memorial line, as expected — Chris died before that shipped, so the feature is still untested and stays on the next me's list.
